title: LFU Cache
description: Design and implement a Least Frequently Used (LFU) cache. When the cache reaches capacity, it invalidates the least frequently used item.
pseudocode:
1. map[key] = {value, freq}
2. freqMap[freq] = List of keys
3. minFreq = 0
4. if get(key): update freqMap and minFreq
5. if put(key, val): if capacity full, remove key from minFreq list, then add key

steps.note: Initialize cache capacity to 2. Put key 1, val 10.
Put key 2, val 20. Cache is now full.
Get key 1. Frequency of key 1 becomes 2.
Put key 3, val 30. Capacity full. Key 2 (freq 1) is evicted.
